speaker: Doctor
text:
Normal nerve conduction studies help rule out peripheral nerve entrapment like carpal tunnel or radial tunnel syndrome. Given the pain radiating to the elbow and the normal wrist findings, I suspect the issue may originate from your cervical spine; do you experience any neck pain or stiffness that radiates down your arm?

The normal cervical X-ray makes a spinal cause unlikely, so we must look closer at the local soft tissue injury from your fall. To confirm De Quervain's tenosynovitis, please perform the Finkelstein test: make a fist with your thumb tucked inside your fingers and gently bend your wrist toward your little finger, and tell me if this reproduces the sharp pain.
